desc:
🚧 HEIST is in early access. Found a bug? Use the in-game Report button. Thanks for playing!
🏦 NEW: THE BANK HEIST (Crew Rank 12)
⚡ 2x XP and 2x Luck this weekend
📜 NEW: Contracts from the Fixer: harder heists for a bigger cut
👍 2,000 likes = a FREE code for everyone!

💰 Welcome to HEIST!
👍 Like the game for more updates!
How to Play:
🕵️ Pull off heists solo or with your crew
🔓 Pick locks, clone fingerprints, crack safes and rewire panels
👀 Sneak past guards and cameras, or go loud and beat the police
🔫 7 guns, with attachments from Weapon Cases
🎒 Grab the loot and make it back to the van
🎲 Every find rolls a rarity, from Common to Jackpot
💵 Sell at the Pawn, or haggle for a better price
⭐ Earn Crew Rank to unlock better gear
📦 Keep your best finds in your stash

🎮 Play on PC, phone, tablet or with a gamepad
